# Edmund Kemper Stories

> A comprehensive true crime documentation of Edmund Kemper, the Co-Ed Killer, covering his biography, victims, criminal psychology, and the 1970s Santa Cruz murder case.

Edmund Kemper Stories is a detailed resource documenting the life, crimes, and psychology of Edmund Kemper, one of California's most notorious serial killers. The site provides victim profiles, biographical information, and historical context about the Co-Ed Killer case that shocked Santa Cruz in the 1970s.

## Key Topics

- Edmund Kemper
- Co-Ed Killer
- Serial killer
